title: Mahaparinirvana Sutra, Part 2
speaker: Zoketsu Norman Fischer
summary: Here's a summary of the talk in one paragraph: The dharma talk explores the impermanence of all things, using stories from the Buddha's life to illustrate this principle. The story of Ananda's awakening highlights the importance of interdependence and humility in spiritual growth, while the Buddha's own passing away is seen as a natural progression towards Nirvana. Ultimately, the talk encourages listeners to cultivate mindfulness and awareness by appreciating all encounters, including those that may seem challenging or unhelpful, and to remember a quiet and peaceful presence at the heart of life and death.
